purpose: Obtain one independently bound static industry source for the sole residual security; no strategy or outcome read.

source.query_date_basis: First observed candidate identity date, fixed before any strategy result; no backward inference from a later listing identity.
source.identity_requirement: Exact code+venue response must be bound to the retained candidate company/security/listing relationship on the query date itself; name similarity or a later identity cannot substitute. Missing evidence yields UNQUALIFIED_IDENTITY_AT_QUERY_DATE.

retry_semantics: Only connection/transport failure before a complete provider response permits the one transport retry. A complete empty, missing, conflicting, malformed or date-invalid response consumes the single semantic query and is terminal.
receipt_requirements: provider fields, query date and provider update date
actual current retrieval timestamp, never backdated
response bytes hash and semantic digest; null before actual retrieval
unique identity and leaf-to-level1 hierarchy validation
absence/conflict disposition without defaults or retries over alternate dates
successor: Independent source qualification may feed a new B-specific input closure; it does not accept B or activate D.
